channel.title: Pause First: One Breath Before the Scroll
channel.description:
One-minute episodes about the moment before you open a distracting app: noticing the urge, asking what you actually need, and choosing on purpose. Calm, practical and judgement-free.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of FocusPass: App Blocker, an iPhone app that blocks the apps you choose and lets you request short, deliberate Passes. FocusPass: App Blocker on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
